questions.question: Infrastructure as Code nima va qaysi asosiy muammolarni hal qiladi?
questions.explanation: Compute, storage va tarmoq resurslarini konsolda qo'lda bosish o'rniga mashina o'qiy oladigan fayllar orqali yaratish, sozlash, boshqarish va versiyalash. Inson konfiguratsiya xatolari va "snowflake server"lar yo'qola...

questions.question: Deklarativ va imperativ IaC'ni misollar bilan solishtiring.
questions.explanation: Deklarativ (Terraform, OpenTofu, Kubernetes YAML): yakuniy holat NIMA bo'lishini aytasiz; engine dependency'larni hisoblab, mos CRUD'larni bajaradi (resource "aws_s3_bucket" "b" { ... }).

questions.question: Terraform state nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: terraform.tfstate — HCL konfiguratsiyani real cloud resurs ID va atributlariga map qiluvchi JSON. Dependency'larni kuzatadi, plan unumdorligi uchun metadata cache'laydi va state locking orqali parallel bajarishni muvo...

questions.question: Asosiy Terraform CLI workflow buyruqlari qanday?
questions.explanation: terraform init — papkani init, provider/modul yuklash, backend sozlash.

questions.question: Terraform `count` va `for_each` farqi.
questions.explanation: count: butun son indeksli ([0, 1, 2]). O'rtadan element olib tashlansa qayta indekslanib keyingi resurslar qayta yaratiladi.

questions.question: Terraform modul nima va DRY'ni qanday ta'minlaydi?
questions.explanation: Birga ishlatiladigan resurslar konteyneri: qayta ishlatiladigan standart komponentlar (VPC, EKS) input variable va output'lar bilan — muhitlar bo'ylab kod takrorlanmaydi.

questions.question: Terraform variables, locals va outputs farqi.
questions.explanation: Variable: modulga beriladigan input parametr.

questions.question: Remote backend nima va nega state locking majburiy?
questions.explanation: State fayl uchun masofaviy ombor (S3 + DynamoDB lock / yangi versiyalarda S3 native lock, Terraform Cloud). Locking bir vaqtda faqat bitta muhandis yoki pipeline apply qilishini ta'minlab, race condition va buzilgan s...

questions.question: OpenTofu nima va nega yaratilgan?
questions.explanation: yil avgustda HashiCorp Terraform litsenziyasini MPL 2.0'dan BSL 1.1 ga o'zgartirdi. Linux Foundation va hamjamiyat 100% ochiq, mos keluvchi fork — OpenTofu'ni yaratdi.

questions.question: IaC'da configuration drift nima va qanday hal qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Konsolda qo'lda o'zgarish sababli kod va jonli resurslar orasidagi farq. Muntazam avtomatik drift detection (terraform plan -detailed-exitcode) va kodni qayta apply qilish (yoki o'zgarishni kodga kiritish) bilan.

questions.question: Terraform'da `moved` bloki nima?
questions.explanation: Resursni qayta nomlash yoki child modulga ko'chirishda jonli resursni o'chirib-yaratmasdan refactoring qilish:

questions.question: Terraform 1.5+ dagi `import {}` bloki nima?
questions.explanation: Mavjud cloud resurslarini kod orqali deklarativ state'ga import qilish; terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf konfiguratsiyani avtomatik generatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: Terraform precondition va postcondition nima?
questions.explanation: lifecycle ichidagi deklarativ tekshiruvlar — resurs yaratilishidan oldin yoki keyin shartlarni tasdiqlaydi:

questions.question: Terragrunt nima va qaysi muammolarni hal qiladi?
questions.explanation: Terraform/OpenTofu ustidagi yupqa wrapper: remote state backend'ni DRY qilish, modul dependency'larini tartibli bajarish (terragrunt run-all apply), plan uchun mock output'lar.

questions.question: Terraform dynamic block nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki takroriy bloklarni (masalan aws_security_group dagi bir nechta ingress) list/map'dan dinamik yaratish.

questions.question: `.terraform.lock.hcl` va `terraform.tfstate` farqi.
questions.explanation: terraform.lock.hcl: provider'larning aniq versiya va hash'lari; Git'ga commit qilinadi.

questions.question: Terraform'da sezgir qiymatlarni qanday himoyalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Variable/output'ga sensitive = true — CLI va CI log'larida ko'rinmaydi. Diqqat: state'da baribir ochiq matn saqlanadi — KMS bilan shifrlangan S3 backend va qat'iy IAM kerak (yangi versiyalarda ephemeral qiymatlar va w...

questions.question: Terratest (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Gruntwork'ning Go kutubxonasi: Terraform bilan haqiqiy infra yaratib, jonli endpoint'larga integration test o'tkazib, keyin o'chiradi.

questions.question: Crossplane (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes'ni universal cloud control plane'ga aylantiradigan CNCF loyihasi — cloud resurslarni CRD sifatida boshqarish va doimiy reconcile.

questions.question: Pulumi (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Infrani umumiy dasturlash tillarida (TypeScript, Python, Go, C#) yozish imkonini beradigan ochiq IaC engine — IDE auto-complete va unit test bilan.

questions.question: Ansible nima va agentless arxitekturasi qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Ochiq automation va configuration management tool: target node'larga standart SSH (Linux) yoki WinRM (Windows) orqali ulanadi, ularga daemon/agent o'rnatmaydi (target'da Python kerak).

questions.question: Ansible idempotency nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook'ni bir yoki ko'p marta bajarish ham bir xil yakuniy holatni beradi (modullar avval holatni tekshiradi; shell/command bundan mustasno — creates/changed_when kerak).

questions.question: Terraform va Ansible farqi.
questions.explanation: Terraform — deklarativ state bilan infra provisioning (VPC, EKS, RDS); Ansible — ishlab turgan serverlarda configuration management (paket o'rnatish, OS fayllarini sozlash). Ko'pincha birga ishlatiladi.

questions.question: `terraform refresh` nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud API'larni so'rab, lokal state'ni real atributlar bilan yangilaydi, infrani o'zgartirmaydi (eskirgan — o'rniga terraform plan/apply -refresh-only).

questions.question: Terraform data source nima?
questions.explanation: Joriy konfiguratsiyadan tashqarida yaratilgan resurslar atributlarini o'qiydigan read-only so'rov (masalan eng yangi Ubuntu AMI ID).

questions.question: `terraform taint` va `terraform apply -replace` farqi.
questions.explanation: taint — eskirgan; terraform apply -replace="aws_instance.web" aniq resursni state'ni oldindan o'zgartirmasdan bitta qadamda qayta yaratadi (plan'da ko'rinadi).

questions.question: Terraform workspace'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta papkadan boshqariladigan alohida state fayllar (terraform workspace select staging). Vaqtinchalik muhitlar uchun qulay; prod izolyatsiyasi uchun papka/akkaunt asosidagi tuzilma afzal.

questions.question: `terraform fmt` nima?
questions.explanation: tf fayllarni kanonik Terraform uslubi va indentatsiyasiga avtomatik keltiradi (CI'da -check).

questions.question: `terraform graph` nima?
questions.explanation: Resurs dependency'larining DAG'ini graphviz uchun DOT formatida chiqaradi.

questions.question: Checkov (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: CI'da Terraform, CloudFormation va Kubernetes manifest'larini xavfsizlik va compliance buzilishlariga skanerlovchi statik tahlil tool'i.

questions.question: IaC uchun tfsec / Trivy nima?
questions.explanation: HCL'ni parse qilib deploy'dan oldin xavflarni (shifrlanmagan storage, public S3, ochiq SG) belgilaydigan tez statik skanerlar.

questions.question: Infracost (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: PR'dagi Terraform kodidan taklif qilingan o'zgarishning aniq oylik xarajat farqini hisoblab, PR'ga izoh qoldiradigan CLI.

questions.question: Atlantis (IaC kontekstida) qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Self-hosted ilova: PR ochilganda terraform plan bajaradi, diff'ni yozadi, state'ni lock qiladi va ruxsatli reviewer atlantis apply deb yozgandagina qo'llaydi.

questions.question: HCP Terraform / Terraform Cloud nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqariladigan platforma: remote execution, markaziy state locking, private modul registry, cost estimation va Sentinel policy.

questions.question: Spacelift (IaC kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation uchun OPA policy va drift detection'ga ega infra orkestratsiya platformasi.

questions.question: Terraform `ignore_changes` nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi tizim yoki autoscaling o'zgartiradigan atributlarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi (lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags, desired_capacity] }).

questions.question: `create_before_destroy` nima?
questions.explanation: Almashtirishda avval yangi resursni yaratib, keyin eskisini o'chiradi — downtime minimal (noyob nom konfliktlariga ehtiyot bo'ling).

questions.question: `prevent_destroy` nima?
questions.explanation: Belgilangan kritik resursni (prod DB) o'chiradigan har qanday planni rad etadi (blok koddan olib tashlansa himoya ham ketadi).

questions.question: Terraform provider alias nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil provider'ning bir nechta nusxasini sozlash (alias = "west") — bitta konfiguratsiyada bir nechta region/akkauntga deploy.

questions.question: Terraform variable precedence qanday?
questions.explanation: Oshib boruvchi ustunlik: env (TF_VAR_name) → terraform.tfvars → terraform.tfvars.json → .auto.tfvars (alifbo tartibida) → CLI -var / -var-file (eng yuqori).

questions.question: `terraform state rm` va `terraform state mv` farqi.
questions.explanation: state rm: resursni state'dan olib tashlaydi; jonli resurs o'chmaydi, Terraform uni boshqarmay qo'yadi (yangi usul: removed bloki).

questions.question: Terraform provider mirroring nima?
questions.explanation: CLI config (.terraformrc) orqali provider binary'larini lokal disk yoki private registry'dan olish — internetsiz (air-gapped) muhitlar uchun.

questions.question: Terraform blast radius nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?
questions.explanation: Yiqilgan apply keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan maksimal zarar. Monolit state'ni qatlamli, ajratilgan state'larga bo'lish (Network → Data → Compute → App) bilan kamaytiriladi; plan ham tezlashadi.

questions.question: Ansible playbook, role va collection farqi.
questions.explanation: Playbook: task va holatlarni target host'larga bog'lovchi YAML.

questions.question: Ansible inventory (statik va dinamik) nima?
questions.explanation: Statik: host va IP'lar ro'yxati INI/YAML faylda.

questions.question: Ansible Vault nima?
questions.explanation: Sezgir o'zgaruvchi, fayl yoki playbook'larni AES-256 bilan shifrlaydi (ansible-vault encrypt secrets.yml).

questions.question: OpenTofu state encryption nima?
questions.explanation: State va plan fayllarini remote backend'ga yuborishdan oldin client tomonda AES-GCM yoki KMS bilan end-to-end shifrlaydigan nativ OpenTofu funksiyasi.

questions.question: Terraform Plugin Framework nima?
questions.explanation: Provider yozish uchun zamonaviy Go SDK: strukturali tiplar, ichki obyekt atributlari va gRPC (protocol v6) qo'llovi.

questions.question: Crossplane'da XRD, Composition va Claim farqi.
questions.explanation: XRD: platform jamoasi abstrakt sxemani belgilaydi (kind: DatabaseInstance).

questions.question: HashiCorp Sentinel nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform Cloud/Enterprise'dagi xususiy Policy as Code framework'i — apply'dan oldin compliance qoidalarini (masalan ruxsat etilmagan EC2 turini bloklash) majburlaydi.

questions.question: Terraform uchun OPA / Conftest nima?
questions.explanation: JSON'ga eksport qilingan Terraform plan'ni CI'da deklarativ Rego xavfsizlik siyosatlariga nisbatan baholash.

questions.question: KubeVela nima?
questions.explanation: Open Application Model (OAM) asosidagi Kubernetes ilova yetkazish platformasi — infra ustida ilova darajasidagi abstraksiyalar.

questions.question: `terraform_remote_state` data source nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa remote state'ning root output'larini o'qiydi — infra qatlamlari orasida kuchsiz bog'lanish (lekin butun state'ga o'qish ruxsati kerak; ko'pincha SSM parameter yoki data source afzal).

questions.question: Terraform `templatefile()` nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi shablon faylni o'zgaruvchilar bilan render qiladi (masalan user_data.sh).

questions.question: `null_resource` va `terraform_data` farqi.
questions.explanation: null_resource (eski): alohida provider yuklashni talab qiladi.

questions.question: `local-exec` va `remote-exec` provisioner farqi.
questions.explanation: local-exec: Terraform ishlayotgan mashinada buyruq.

questions.question: Provider dependency lock nima?
questions.explanation: terraform.lock.hcl da provider checksum'larini qotiradi — jamoa va CI aynan bir xil provider binary'larini yuklaydi.

questions.question: Terraform `self` reference nima?
questions.explanation: provisioner yoki connection bloklari ichida resursning o'z atributlariga murojaat qiluvchi obyekt.

questions.question: Terraform Module Registry nima?
questions.explanation: Versiyalangan qayta ishlatiladigan modullarni topish va tarqatish uchun public yoki private repo.

questions.question: `terraform force-unlock` nima?
questions.explanation: Oldingi run kutilmaganda yiqilganda qolib ketgan remote state lock'ni bo'shatadi: terraform force-unlock <LOCK-ID> (boshqa run ishlamayotganiga ishonch hosil qiling).
